items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: I can’t remember if it was Jerry or Mike, was on the ship.

ctx.x: The Andrea Doria, right. And so the one of them, I can’t remember if it was Jerry or Mike, was on the ship. And so it went down as the ship was coming in. And I know they lost a lot of people. And he goes oh my God, I hope he’s okay. And as soon as he got there, oh thanks, blah, blah, blah. And then he tells them, once he tells him he’s alive, he goes, “Hey by the way,” you know, “we’ve got a big hit.” He goes, you know, because this was a couple of years later after she did it. He goes, “Yeah, it’s ‘Hound Dog.’”…
Memphis and he would go see uh, what’s his name, the guy who did, the black piano player who married the one girl and slapped her around, oh God.
